summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing of Feature #5: Multi-Document Portfolio Review. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (100%) — empty doc list=400, invalid client_id=404, non-existent doc ids=404 with 'document analyses' detail, requires-auth=401/403, happy-path generate (GPT-4o aggregation, ~10s) returns success=true with title, executive_summary, aggregate_metrics{number_of_products, weighted_eac_estimate, asset_allocation, tax_wrappers_used}, recommendations, client_friendly_summary; list endpoint returns array containing new id; GET single returns rec; GET bogus=404; DELETE returns 200 and subsequent GET=404; DELETE bogus=404. Frontend: Admin logged in via UI, /portfolio-review loaded (portfolio-review-page testid), 1 document row+checkbox rendered, 0-doc Generate shows 'Pick at least one' error, ticking doc + advisor notes + Generate produced review-output within ~20s. exec-summary visible. Output text contains all expected section labels: Total Value, Products, EAC, Annual Fees, Recommendations, Summary, Diversification, Retirement, Fee Audit. History tab listed 2 rows (one from previous backend test was left + new one), Open re-loaded a review, Delete removed (2->1, dialog accepted). Dashboard '/' Advisor Workflow section contains 'Report Builder', 'Compliance', 'Portfolio Review' and 'Multi-Document' card title. RoleGate negative: TEST_ind_<ts>@example.com (role=individual) registered via /api/auth/register (full_name field), logged in, visited /portfolio-review — role-gate-blocker testid present, 'Financial Advisors only' message shown, portfolio-review-page NOT rendered. Confirmed advisor-only gating works.

issues: The exact text 'Email Generator' was not found in dashboard body text — same nit raised in iteration_24 (likely card titled 'AI Email Generator' or similar). The other 3 cards (Report Builder, Compliance, Portfolio Review / Multi-Document) are present. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional/minor, carry-over) Verify the Advisor Workflow card title for the Email Generator matches the spec wording on Dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio_review.py: clean implementation — advisor_id scoping on all queries, _id excluded, JSON parse fallback sets _parse_error=true, GPT-4o session_id randomised, document list capped at 20, context per doc truncated to 2500 chars (good token guard).
POST /generate has no rate limiting — GPT-4o calls are billed. Consider per-advisor throttle (non-blocking).
PortfolioReview.jsx renders Recharts PieChart/BarChart only when allocation/product_breakdown have data — graceful 'Insufficient data' fallback handled.

No backend role enforcement on portfolio_review endpoints — relies on frontend RoleGate. Individual users with a valid token could still call /api/portfolio-review/* directly (their advisor_id filter would just return empty). Not a security risk for data leakage, but worth a future server-side advisor-only decorator for consistency with FAIS positioning.
